'''Karp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where she built and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop.
